thread:
amanda: Heads-up: seeing decode tail latency regression on small-batch streams after latest FlashAttention-fusion change. Repro on perf nightlies.

josh: Can you paste perf numbers?

amanda: Quick summary: prefill numbers look unchanged. Decode p95 up ~1.8x for batch_size <= 4, seq_len 1..32. Microbench shows decode path is now picking fused-attn variant which is slower for tiny KV shapes.

priya: Interesting — the paged-attn variant we had avoided fusion for small kv_pages. Maybe fused kernel launch/warps overhead dominates at tiny sizes.

ryan: I ran a quick nvprof capture on the repro run. Kernel durations: 
```
# decode_smallbatch_fused
kernel_launch: 120.3us
kv_memcpy: 22.4us
other: 8.1us
# decode_smallbatch_old
kernel_launch: 44.7us
kv_memcpy: 9.8us
```
Looks like both launch + memcpy are higher.

ciara: Is the continuous batching tweak we merged last week relevant? We changed the early-aggregation logic for decode which might coalesce different small requests differently.

amanda: It is related. Continuous batching improved throughput for medium loads, but the kernel-selection heuristic we added prefers fused when total_seq_pages % 1 == 0 (stupid simplification) which causes fusion to be chosen for many tiny decode batches. Need smarter tie-breakers.

josh: Proposal: change heuristic to prefer small-batch decode kernel when decode_batch_size <= 4 OR avg_kv_pages <= 2. Also add a warmup ramp to measure actual kernel cost per shard.

priya: +1. Also consider kv cache fragmentation: when kv_pages > 8, fallback to paged-attn; when kv_pages in [2..8] prefer small-batch kernel unless fusion shows >20% uplift in microbench.

perf-bot: Nightly bench run 1796000000 complete: decode_smallbatch_fused vs decode_smallbatch_old: p95 78us -> 140us (+79%). Details: seq=16, bs=2, kv_pages=1.

ryan: I'll spin an A/B with two changes: (1) heuristic: if bs<=4 prefer small kernel, (2) skip fusion when kv_pages<=2. Running on a 4-GPU rig now, will post numbers in ~20m.

amanda: Also, add trace tag `kernel_choice:{fused|small|paged}` and `kv_pages` to request logs for 24h so we can quantify in-prod fallout. If we see many real requests matching worst-case, we may hotfix revert to previous selection.

ciara: Sounds good. If A/B fixes, we should add unit microbench that asserts fused <= small for bs<=4 for future PRs.

amanda: Agreed. Action items:
- ryan: run A/B and post bench raw CSV (1796001400)
- josh/priya: propose updated heuristic PR + microbench test
- ciara: add tracing flags and retention 24h
- amanda: monitor nightlies and coordinate rollback if needed

ryan: Running now. Posting output when done.

ciara: :thumbsup:
